jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Logistics at full potential.

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

1st Shift, Monday – Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm

You have a passion for logistics, and you know how to keep things moving and operations running smoothly. As the Manager, Supply Chain Site Operations, you’ll be responsible for the efficient operation of the warehouse, including order fulfillment, shipping/receiving and inventory control activities. In this role, you’ll have a starring role in helping us continue to provide outstanding solutions for our global customers.

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and the opportunity to participate in a company incentive plan.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

-
Oversee operational and personnel activities in the facility and ensure the safe, clean and efficient operation of the site

-
Hire, train, develop and evaluate staff effectively, consulting with the HR team as needed

-
Maintain work schedules and work assignments

-
Ensure time and attendance is properly maintained, monitored and approved in a timely manner

-
Ensure efficient utilization of all equipment and the coordination of maintenance needs

-
Maintain and model the 7S Workplace Organization standard; ensure all safety procedures and policies are followed

-
Partner with staff to manage and always maintain appropriate stock

-
Ensure compliance with specified contract metrics

-
Maintain high standards of operational efficiency

-
Ensure quality management system procedures are implemented throughout functional groups

-
Focus on productivity, quality and safety requirements in accordance with company needs and customer requirements

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

-
5 years of experience in a supply chain, warehousing or distribution environment

-
5 years managerial/supervisory experience

-
Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook) and computerized scanner equipment

-
Availability to work a flexible schedule as needed, including planned and unplanned overtime, which may include weekends

It’d be great if you also have:

-
Bachelor’s or master’s degree

-
Bilingual English/Spanish

-
Lean, Six Sigma and Continuous Process Improvement knowledge and experience

-
Experience in an AS9100 or ISO environment

-
Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) experience

-
Working knowledge of financial accounting, including developing and/or managing a P&L; experience with HR practices

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

jobs.title: National Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Ready to lead a large-scale, unionised transport network operation where you can shape business strategy, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver best-in-class safety, compliance, and operational performance across the UK? Are you a strategic  National Transport Operations Manager with the experience to drive operational excellence, commercial performance, and customer success across a diverse national contract?

As National Operations Manager , you'll lead the end-to-end delivery of the Valero operation, overseeing a nationally dispersed fuel network. This is a highly visible senior leadership role where you'll balance commercial performance, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, safety, and compliance, while leading large, multi-site teams across the UK.

Working closely with senior customer stakeholders, Trade Union representatives, and GXO leadership teams, you'll drive continuous improvement, influence business strategy, and create a culture where people, performance, and service excellence thrive. If you're passionate about leading at scale and making a lasting impact, this is an opportunity to shape the future of a high-profile national operation.

This is a full-time 40 hours contracted per week, permanent opportunity. Working Monday to Friday (flexibility required for business needs), across 10 sites.  It would be beneficial to be based in the Manchester/Midlands area.

Pay, benefits and more:

We’re looking to offer a salary of up to  £70,000 per annum , and 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays). Your benefits package includes a company car OR car allowance to the value of £6,000 PA, private medical insurance, a company sponsored pension scheme, life assurance and access to our benefits platform, including retail discounts

What you’ll do on a typical day:

- Lead the end-to-end operational performance of the Valero contract, driving service excellence, safety, compliance, and productivity across a nationally dispersed transport network

- Take full accountability for contract profitability, budget management, cost control, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and commercial performance

- Champion a strong culture of health, safety, wellbeing, and regulatory compliance, ensuring robust governance and operational standards are maintained across all locations

- Build and maintain strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders, acting as the key operational lead for contract governance, service delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives

- Inspire and develop high-performing teams while fostering positive Trade Union relationships, leading industrial relations activity, succession planning, talent development, and workforce engagement

What you need to succeed at GXO:

- Proven leadership experience within transport operations, with a strong track record of managing large-scale, multi-site environments and delivering outstanding customer outcomes (International CPC would be great!)

- Strong commercial acumen, with experience owning budgets, driving profitability, managing operational costs, and identifying opportunities for growth and continuous improvement

- Extensive experience leading operational teams within unionised environments, including stakeholder engagement, collective consultation, negotiation, and industrial relations management

- In-depth knowledge of transport operations, compliance, risk management, and legislative requirements, with the ability to champion the highest standards of safety and operational excellence

- Inspirational leadership skills, with the ability to influence, develop, and engage teams across multiple locations

jobs.title: EMEA EHS Account Program Manager
jobs.description:
EMEA EHS Account Program Manager

Location: Ideally based in Amsterdam, Netherlands but we will also consider applications from within EMEA as this role includes regular travel across EMEA and United Kingdom including Amsterdam

Department: QE3SH

Contract type: Permanent

Logistics at full potential

We’re looking for an EMEA EHS Accounts Program Manager to lead the strategic oversight and governance of Environment, Health and Safety programs for a designated global technology industry, customer across the EMEA region. You’ll ensure alignment with regulatory requirements, GXO standards and customer expectations, while driving a culture of prevention, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.

In this role, you’ll establish, lead and maintain EMEA Safety Governance and Steering Committees, providing performance transparency and proactive risk management across multiple countries and business units. You’ll act as the primary EHS strategic partner for the customer, building trusted relationships and ensuring agreed safety deliverables, performance expectations and improvement initiatives are delivered.

You’ll report directly to the VP Safety EU/UK&I and work closely with senior customer stakeholders, the Strategic Account Director, and GXO operational and EHS leadership teams

What you’ll do:

- Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the EMEA EHS program for the account, driving continuous improvement through a strong governance framework

- Act as a senior EHS partner and trusted advisor to customer leadership, aligning GXO and customer EHS objectives

- Lead EMEA Safety Steering Committees and governance forums to manage risk, monitor performance and ensure consistent execution

- Partner with Operations, HR, Engineering, Security, Real Estate, Business Development and customer leadership teams to embed EHS excellence

- Ensure compliance with applicable EHS legislation, customer requirements and GXO standards across the account portfolio

- Maintain and improve the Account Safety Management System, including policies, procedures, controls and governance processes

- Define, agree and monitor strategic EHS objectives and KPIs with customer and GXO leadership teams

- Lead executive-level performance reporting, providing insight, analysis and recommendations

- Identify, assess and mitigate strategic and operational EHS risks across account operations

- Oversee incident management, root cause analysis, trend analysis, corrective actions and prevention planning

- Lead EHS training, awareness and engagement programmes that strengthen capability and safety culture

- Coordinate customer audits, regulatory inspections and corporate reviews, ensuring audit readiness and timely closure of actions

- Support sustainability and environmental performance, including energy, waste, emissions, resource use and environmental reporting

- Conduct periodic site visits, support customer meetings and audits, and provide hands-on support during new programme and process deployments

What you’ll need to succeed at GXO

- More than five years’ experience managing EHS and compliance programmes for multinational customers, ideally in logistics, manufacturing, technology or another fast-paced operational environment

- Strong knowledge of EHS management systems and international and local EHS regulations

- Proven experience delivering EHS governance, risk management, compliance and continuous improvement across multiple countries

- Ability to build trusted relationships with senior customer, operational and leadership stakeholders

- Strong communication, presentation and training skills in English

- Excellent decision-making, stakeholder influencing and conflict management skills

- Strong results orientation with the ability to manage competing priorities and multiple strategic initiatives

- Experience supporting fast-growing operations, new business implementations, launches or operational change

- Flexibility to travel internationally including regular travel to Amsterdam

It would be great if you also have:

- EHS qualifications in the Netherlands or Scandinavia

- Dangerous Goods qualifications

- Experience working with customer-facing EHS programmes for strategic or global key accounts

- Experience with safety technology platforms, data-led reporting or automated EHS management tools

What we offer:

- Competitive salary plus benefits and company car

- Clear and visible career paths within a global organisation that invests in leadership development and internal progression

- A culture built on safety, teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement, where your ideas and leadership can make a real difference

Why join GXO?

At GXO, safety is at the heart of how we operate. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone goes home safe every day and where our people can grow, contribute and succeed. You’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative and technology-led business that invests in its people and helps customers build faster, smarter, leaner and safer supply chains.

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Hoogeveen
jobs.description:
Lead a fast-paced logistics operation supporting a well-established Dutch supermarket

Are you an experienced Operations Manager who knows how to lead large operational teams, drive performance through KPIs and keep people engaged in a busy, high-volume logistics environment?

At GXO’s site in Hoogeveen , you’ll play a key leadership role in an operation supporting a well-established Dutch supermarket customer. You’ll manage and influence a team that can range from approximately 70 to 250 colleagues across three shifts, ensuring the operation runs safely, efficiently and consistently for one of the most recognisable names in Dutch retail.

This is a Monday to Friday role, working 08:00 to 17:00, but you’ll have visibility across the full three-shift operation. You’ll balance day-to-day execution with people leadership, customer service, productivity, absenteeism management and continuous improvement — making sure the site delivers against its operational targets while building a positive, accountable and safety-first culture.

What you’ll lead

As Operations Manager, you’ll be responsible for driving operational performance across the Hoogeveen site, working closely with your leadership team, support functions and the customer to deliver safe, productive and reliable operations. You will:

- Lead daily warehouse operations across a three-shift environment, ensuring safety, service, quality and productivity expectations are consistently met

- Manage, coach and develop a large operational team of approximately 70 to 250 colleagues, creating clear expectations, accountability and engagement across shifts

- Drive performance through KPIs, dashboards and operational data, taking ownership of productivity, labour planning, workforce utilisation and cost control

- Work proactively with HR and site leadership to manage absenteeism, support performance conversations and maintain a positive, inclusive working environment

- Build a strong customer partnership while championing health and safety, continuous improvement, process standardisation and practical problem-solving across the operation

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a confident, people-focused operations leader who enjoys working in a fast-paced logistics environment and knows how to translate performance data into practical action. You’ll ideally bring:

- Previous experience as an Operations Manager, Warehouse Manager or Shift Leader within logistics, warehousing, retail distribution, supply chain or a comparable fast-paced environment

- Experience leading large operational teams, ideally across multiple shifts, with the ability to engage, coach and influence through others

- Strong experience working with KPIs, productivity targets, service levels, quality measures and operational reporting

- Confidence analysing performance data, identifying root causes and taking clear action to close gaps and improve results

- Experience managing absenteeism, performance conversations and people-related challenges in partnership with HR and site leadership

- A strong commitment to health and safety, with the confidence to challenge unsafe behaviours and maintain high standards across the operation

- A hands-on, resilient and solutions-focused leadership style, with the ability to stay calm and effective under pressure

- Experience with continuous improvement, Lean principles or structured problem-solving would be an advantage

- Good working knowledge of warehouse systems, reporting tools and Excel

- Strong communication skills in English and Dutch essential

What’s in it for you

- A visible Operations Manager role at GXO’s Hoogeveen site, supporting a well-established Dutch supermarket customer

- Monday to Friday working hours, 08:00 to 17:00, while staying connected to a dynamic three-shift operation – you will be expected to be ‘on-call’ via telephone for one week in every three to ensure any issues are managed effectively outside of core working hours

- The opportunity to lead a sizeable team, influence performance and make a direct impact on safety, productivity and service

- A role where your ability to use KPIs, manage absenteeism and improve operational discipline will be recognised and valued

- Clear and visible career paths within a global organisation that invests in leadership development and internal progression

- A culture built on safety, teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement, where your ideas and leadership can make a real difference

Unlock the potential of your future!

Working at GXO Logistics means working in a dynamic and international organization. A fascinating environment with plenty of room for personal input and development. jobs.description:

At our site in Lelystad, we are looking for an engaging and motivated Head of Operations for the Ironing Factory.  This is a fantastic opportunity to really lead from the front and take the lead for a busy logistics operation of approximately 50 permanent employees and 100+ flex employees. - Significant experience in warehouse, logistics, supply chain or a comparable fast-paced operational environment

- A strong track record of leading leaders and developing operational teams through coaching, clear expectations and visible leadership

- A genuine commitment to health and safety, with the confidence to challenge, improve standards and build a proactive safety culture

- Experience owning operational and financial performance, including P&L budgets, labour costs, productivity and performance improvement

- The ability to stay calm, resilient and solutions-focused under pressure, without compromising safety, quality or people standards

- Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to turn data into practical action on the floor

- A continuous improvement mindset, with experience using structured problem-solving and process improvement approaches

- Strong communication skills in English; Dutch or Spanish language skills would be an advantage

- The confidence to partner with customers, support functions and senior stakeholders while remaining connected to the day-to-day operation

What’s in it for you

- A senior leadership role with real ownership of your own GXO site in Lelystad

- The opportunity to shape a safety-first, people-focused operation and make a visible impact from day one

- Clear and visible career paths within a global organisation that invests in leadership development and internal progression

- A culture built on safety, teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement, where your ideas and leadership will be valued

- The chance to lead a stable operation while continuing to raise standards, improve processes and develop future talent

Your work environment

Working at GXO Logistics means working in a dynamic and international organization. A fascinating environment with plenty of room for personal input and development. jobs.title: Senior Analyst FP&A F/H
jobs.description:
MISSIONS

Afin de soutenir notre développement actuel, nous recrutons un(e) Senior Analyst FP&A F/H .

En tant qu'Analyste FP&A intervenant pour notre région Europe Continentale, vous travaillez avec les départements et pays assignés, les dirigeants régionaux et mondiaux de l'entreprise en préparant des rapports financiers, des analyses et des prévisions, et en travaillant avec les principales parties prenantes pour atteindre les objectifs.

A ce titre, vos principales missions consistent à :
- Participer aux processus de budgétisation, de planification et de prévision, en travaillant de manière transversale pour influencer les parties prenantes
- Maintenir et assurer l'exactitude des modèles de prévision, y compris : Chiffre d'affaires, marge, EBITDA, EBITA, dépenses d'exploitation, KPIs et leviers financiers et opérationnels, Capex, Free Cash Flow
- Participer aux revues opérationnelles mensuelles en préparant des présentations pour la direction qui communiquent clairement les performances opérationnelles et financières, ainsi que les problèmes nécessitant une intervention, leur statut et les solutions suggérées
- Créer des rapports de gestion et des visuels efficaces qui vont droit au but et permettent à nos cadres dirigeants de prendre des décisions rapides en toute connaissance de cause
- Identifier les risques et les opportunités dans plusieurs secteurs d'activité afin de garantir la précision des prévisions
- Générer, maintenir et assurer l'exactitude des tableaux de bord financiers et opérationnels pour diverses lignes d'activité dans le cadre du processus d'examen financier hebdomadaire / mensuel / trimestriel ; déterminer les principaux facteurs de sur- ou de sous-performance
- Mettre au point des outils permettant d'identifier rapidement les problèmes et les opportunités, et formuler des recommandations
- Établir des rapports ad hoc pour soutenir plusieurs parties prenantes dans un environnement matriciel interfonctionnel et multi-pays, en équilibrant leurs besoins et leurs points de vue afin de maximiser les intérêts de l'entreprise
- Effectuer des travaux d'extraction et de traitement de données à partir de grandes quantités de données et d'informations afin d'obtenir des analyses fiables (formules Excel avancées et tableaux croisés dynamiques).

PROFIL

Issu(e) d’une formation supérieur en Finance et/ou Comptabilité, vous justifiez d’une expérience significative acquise dans le domaine de la planification et de l'analyse financière (FP&A), y compris en matière de budgétisation et de prévision.

Vous disposez d’une excellente connaissance des outils de consolidation financière, de reporting et d'analyse (Hyperion Financial Management, EPBCS, Excel Smart View, etc.).

Vous bénéficiez de solides capacités et compétences pour communiquer efficacement des concepts financiers complexes à diverses populations financières et opérationnelles.

Vous faites preuve d’un réel esprit critique, à remettre en question et à exploiter les ressources disponibles pour résoudre les problèmes liés à l'établissement des rapports et les anomalies dans les données.

Votre capacité à maintenir et à développer des tableaux de bord Microsoft Power BI fiables, sécurisés et conviviaux en collaboration avec l'équipe Corporate BI est un véritable atout.

Enfin, vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais totalement opérationnel.

Soucieux de promouvoir l'égalité des chances, GXO encourage la diversité, notamment en faveur des femmes et des personnes en situation de handicap, et s'engage à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous.

GXO est l'un des principaux prestataires de services de transport et de logistique pour les entreprises les plus performantes au monde. Nous aidons nos clients à gérer leurs marchandises à travers toute leur supply chain le plus efficacement possible en utilisant notre technologie et nos services. Notre équipe internationale est notre principale force : nos collaborateurs énergiques et innovants disposant d’expériences et de talents variés font de GXO un endroit où il fait bon travailler.

Are you an experienced logistics leader looking for a high‑profile operational role? Do you thrive in a fast‑paced 3PL environment where safety, service and stakeholder management are key? If you're commercially focused, people‑driven and passionate about delivering excellence, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

We’re looking for an experienced Operations Manager to lead our GXO operation supporting our customer Arbex (formerly Kimberley Clark) at our site in Chorley . In this pivotal role, you will oversee site operations, ensuring compliance, service excellence, and the delivery of KPI and SLA targets. You will lead warehouse teams, build strong customer and depot relationships, manage costs, and drive a safe and efficient operation in line with GXO values.

This is a full‑time, permanent position , working Monday to Friday between the hours of 08:00 – 16:00, with some flexibility required.

Pay, benefits and more:

We’re looking to offer a salary of up to £50,000.00 per annum and 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays. Your benefits package includes a company sponsored pension scheme, private medical & dental insurance, a 24/7 online GP service, life assurance and a fully comprehensive employee assistance programme. You’ll also have access to our MyBenefits platform offering a variety of high street discounts, a cycle to work scheme, cashback cards, a saving scheme and much more!

What you’ll do on a typical day:

- Lead, recruit, train, and develop Team Leaders and warehouse colleagues, driving performance and succession planning

- Ensure compliance with Health & Safety standards, UK regulations, company policies, and all required training requirements

- Create and maintain a safe, engaged, and productive working environment, ensuring clear communication across all teams

- Build strong relationships with internal and external customers, identifying opportunities to improve operational performance and service delivery

- Oversee workforce administration, including time and attendance, payroll processes, resource planning, and operational issue resolution, while supporting wider business needs

What you need to succeed at GXO:

- Senior management experience within logistics, supply chain or a similar process-driven operational environment ( a process driven environment e.g. automated, manufacturing in a food/pharmaceutical/white goods/e-commerce environment or warehousing )

- Excellent colleague management/leadership skills ideally with experience in a unionised environment

- Excellent communication and influencing capability, with a data‑driven approach to decision‑making

- Solid understanding of compliance, legislation, audit requirements and operational governance

- Experience delivering continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma, CI) and driving operational excellence Technology savvy – familiar with WMS, SAP, MS Office and automated environments

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.
GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. GXO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate, support and thrive on diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.  We believe that diversity and inclusion in our business is critical to our success as a global company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. We are an Armed Forces friendly organisation and Disability Confident Leader as part of the Disability Confident Scheme (GIS) and actively welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement here.

jobs.description:

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

1st Shift, Monday - Friday, 7:00am - 4:00pm

As the Inventory Operations Manager, you will oversee critical operational areas that keep the business running efficiently while ensuring inventory accuracy, customer satisfaction, and team success. Leveraging your leadership experience, you will monitor trends, analyze operational challenges, implement process improvements, and provide coaching and development to team members. In this role, you will champion GXO's values by driving operational excellence, fostering an engaged workforce, and supporting continuous growth for both the team and the organization. .

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

-
Supervise the Inventory Control team members, ensuring company policies are enforced

-
Maintain the integrity of inventory records while following established procedures

-
Research complex transaction histories to reconcile discrepancies

-
Communicate effectively with all levels of management and customer representatives

-
Provide leadership and training to accomplish company goals and objectives

-
Coordinate activities for team members, ensuring effective use of productive working hours

-
Investigate all facets of facilities operations to troubleshoot processes and make/recommended improvements

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

-
4 years of inventory control experience

-
Proficiency in Microsoft Office

-
Experience with computerized scanner equipment

-
Availability to work a flexible schedule as needed, including planned and unplanned overtime, which may include weekends

It’d be great if you also have:

-
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work or military experience

-
APICS or CSCMP certifications

-
5 years of inventory control experience including slotting and unit measures

-
5 years of supervisory or managerial experience

-
Ability to quickly learn and achieve proficiency in new software applications

-
Solid time management and multitasking skills

-
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to present clean, organized and thorough information and data appropriate for intended audience

-
Self-motivated work style with excellent analytical and math skills

-
Solid attention to detail and follow-up skills with the ability to identify and resolve problems

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Ready to take full ownership of inventory, systems, and compliance in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment? Can you inspire teams and influence stakeholders at every level to deliver outstanding operational performance? Do you have what it takes to turn complex data into actionable insights that drive efficiency, performance, and compliance?

Here at GXO, we’re looking for a motivated Operations Manager to join our BAE Systems site based in Glasgow . You will be responsible for the effective management of inventory operations, warehouse systems, and associated data, ensuring alignment with customer, contractual, regulatory, health & safety and internal governance standards.

This is a full-time, permanent position. You’ll be working Monday to Friday 07:00 - 16:30 .

Pay, benefits and more:

We’re looking to offer a salary of up to £46,000 per annum. Alongside your pay, you'll benefit from a company pension scheme, 33 days of holiday including bank holidays, cycle to work scheme, and access to an employee discount platform covering retail, tech, travel and more. Onsite parking is available, and we’re committed to your growth through training, multiskilling, and clear career progression opportunities. You’ll be part of a supportive team culture that values safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

- Motivate and manage a team of Team Leaders and MTOs to meet and exceed performance objectives

- Effectively manage resources to achieve and report on operational KPI’s across receiving, Putaway, DRL dwell time, NC returns, cycle counting, stock integrity & operational cost.

- Create and review performance reports, making recommendations for improvements

- Ensure a proactive approach to Health & Safety using reporting and ensuring team members comply with Health & Safety policies

- Where necessary, support with disciplinary and grievance meetings ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures

What you need to succeed at GXO:

- You will be a strong communicator and problem solver with the ability to analyse operational data, identify improvement opportunities, and implement solutions that enhance productivity, accuracy, and efficiency

- Proven ability to manage stock accuracy, system governance and compliance in safety‑critical or customer‑audited operations

- Strong people‑management experience, including performance management, training, engagement and continuous improvement delivery

- Sound working knowledge of health & safety, quality and compliance requirements

jobs.title: Operations Manager - 1st Shift
jobs.description:
Logistics at full potential.

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

1st, Monday - Friday, 7:00am - 3:30pm

As the Manager, Supply Chain Operations, you will oversee several important areas that are critical to keeping our operations running smoothly. We’ll count on your skills and years of experience to be a champion of our values, ensuring an engaged workforce, loyal customers, efficient operations and a bright future for yourself and GXO.

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

- Communicate with customers, vendors and team members to ensure customer commitments are met

- Demonstrate an understanding of GXO’s quality policies; establish procedures for maintaining quality objectives

- Provide guidance to supervisors with respect to personnel, quality and safety

- Hire, train, develop and appraise staff effectively

- Make recommendations on programs to improve operations

- Handle equipment and coordinate all maintenance needs with the maintenance team

- Ensure records are maintained appropriately and reports are completed in a timely manner

- Adhere to and enforce all safe work practices, ensuring the warehouse is compliant with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) and other pertinent standards/regulations

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

- 4 years of relevant work experience

- Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) and computerized scanner equipment

- Availability to work a flexible schedule as needed, including planned and unplanned overtime, which may include weekends

It’d be great if you also  have:

- Bachelor's degree in Logistics or a related field

- 4 years of managerial/supervisory experience

- Experience in an AS9100 or ISO environment

- Lean, Six Sigma and Continuous Process Improvement knowledge and experience

- Experience in warehousing or Third-Party Logistics (3PL)

- Ability to maintain a safe work environment by monitoring and enforcing safety procedures across all departments

- Strong problem-solving techniques and statistical analysis skills

This job requires the ability to:

- Lift objects of various shapes, sizes, and weights

- Stand, sit or walk for extended periods of time

- Reach (including above your head), bend, climb, push, pull, twist, squat and kneel

- Tolerate hot or cold warehouse environments

We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Manager Site
jobs.description:
Why this role matters

Are you passionate about driving operational excellence and creating lasting improvements? At GXO Logistics, we are looking for a Continuous Improvement Manager Site who thrives in a fast-paced 3PL environment and enjoys working closely with operational teams to make a real impact.

Based at our Tilburg site, supporting a leading Fashion & Retail customer, you will play a key role in embedding Lean principles, coaching teams, and delivering sustainable process improvements that enhance performance across the operation.

What's in it for you

- A competitive salary in line with your experience level

- Career development opportunities within a fast-growing international organization

- The opportunity to lead impactful improvement initiatives with real business influence

- Plenty of room for ownership, initiative, and professional growth

- A collaborative, people-focused culture

How you'll make an impact

- Lead the implementation and deployment of the Lean program across the Tilburg site, driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance, quality, and efficiency

- Develop and deliver Lean training, coaching teams on methodologies such as Kaizen, 5S, Gemba, and structured problem-solving techniques

- Partner with Operations and the QESH team to standardize processes and ensure work instructions remain accurate, practical, and up to date

- Lead and develop the onsite Training team, providing coaching and support to the Team Lead and eight trainers to build capability across the operation

- Act as a trusted Continuous Improvement partner across the site by sharing best practices, facilitating collaboration, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement

What you'll bring to GXO

- A university degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or a related field

- Experience in a Continuous Improvement role within a 3PL logistics or similarly complex operational environment

- Strong knowledge of Lean methodologies, including Kaizen, 5S, waste reduction, and process improvement

- Experience coaching, training, and engaging teams to drive operational excellence

- Fluent English language skills; Dutch is an advantage

Your work environment

Working at GXO Logistics means being part of a dynamic and international organization where no two days are the same. You’ll have the opportunity to develop yourself to your full potential, supported by a company that values entrepreneurship, growth, and sustainability.

With a strong focus on customer satisfaction, employee development, and innovation, GXO is proud to be one of the top logistics service providers worldwide.

jobs.description:
HR Manager Site – Lelystad Platform

Lead the People Agenda Behind One of GXO's Largest Logistics Operations

As HR Manager for our Lelystad platform, you will sit at the heart of a complex, high-volume logistics operation where people performance and business performance go hand in hand.

Cooperating directly with senior site leadership, you will lead the people strategy for a large operational workforce, driving measurable improvements in engagement, retention, leadership capability and organizational effectiveness. This is a highly visible role with significant influence, requiring a leader who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver sustainable business results.

If you are energized by solving complex workforce challenges, influencing senior stakeholders and creating high-performing teams, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

What you will lead

- Own and drive the site people plan, translating operational priorities into clear HR actions that improve performance, engagement and stability

- Act as a trusted partner to senior site leaders, bringing challenge, insight and practical solutions to decisions that affect a large operational workforce

- Lead, coach and develop a team of 4 HR advisers and 2 admin, creating a high-performing HR function with clear priorities, strong delivery and visible impact

- Use workforce data and business insight to identify trends, address root causes and deliver measurable improvements in absence, retention, engagement and leadership effectiveness

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
HR Business Partner - Zellik and Mechelen

Role Summary

The HR Business Partner provides end-to-end HR support across  multiple operational sites  in Belgium within a dynamic, fast-paced, and matrixed organization. Reporting to the HR BU Manager, this role operates with a high degree of autonomy and requires strong prioritization across locations.

Approximately  65% of the role is focused on operational HR delivery across sites , ensuring stable, consistent, and compliant people processes, while 35% is dedicated to tactical and strategic HR initiatives  aligned with medium- to long-term business objectives.

You act as a  key HR partner for site leadership across multiple locations , combining hands-on delivery with the ability to translate business needs into scalable HR solutions. Success in this role requires resilience, strong judgment, and the ability to balance multiple site priorities , while maintaining alignment with HR strategy.

A strong emphasis is placed on:

- Building trusted relationships across sites

- Driving process improvement through deep-dive analysis

- Operating as a true team player, closely supporting and enabling the HR Officer

Key Responsibilities

- Act as the HR contact and trusted advisor across multiple sites , ensuring consistent HR support and alignment.

- Build strong, visible relationships with site leadership teams , fostering trust and proactive collaboration.

- Operate across sites to ensure continuity, consistency, and quality of HR service delivery , even in complex and resource-constrained environments.

- Manage daily operational HR topics  including employee relations, absence, performance, disciplinaries, grievances, and policy application.

- Coach and advise managers across sites on people management, leadership behaviors, and employment matters .

- Ensure compliance with labor laws, works council agreements, and internal policies , escalating risks as needed.

Process Improvement & Deep Dive Focus

- Take ownership in identifying opportunities for process improvement and standardization across sites .

- Perform deep-dive analyses on HR trends  (e.g., absenteeism, turnover, engagement, performance issues) to identify root causes.

- Translate insights into practical, sustainable improvement actions , driving measurable impact.

- Challenge current ways of working and simplify complex processes  to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

Multi-Site Operations

- Balance priorities across multiple locations, ensuring equitable support and clear communication .

- Drive consistency in HR practices and employee experience across sites , while allowing for local nuances where needed.

- Act as a connector between sites to share best practices and lessons learned .

Team Collaboration & HR Officer Support

- Act as a true team player within the HR team , working closely with the HR Officer.

- Provide guidance, coaching, and back-up support to the HR Officer , ensuring smooth operational execution.

- Collaborate on workload distribution and jointly drive HR initiatives and operational excellence .

- Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment , supporting collective outcomes over individual focus.

Strategic & Tactical Contribution

- Support workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, and the full employee lifecycle across sites.

- Contribute to engagement, talent development, succession planning, and organizational changes .

- Support and drive change management initiatives across multiple locations .

- Partner with HR COEs (e.g., payroll, C&B, L&D, recruitment) to ensure effective and consistent program implementation.

What you need to succeed at GXO

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field.

- 8+ years of progressive HR experience, including strong business partnering exposure.

- Proven experience supporting multiple sites or operating in a geographically dispersed environment .

- Strong knowledge of employment law, employee relations, and HR best practices.

- Experience in matrixed and operational environments is highly desirable.

- Fluency in English, French, and Dutch.

Key Competencies

- Strong ability to operate effectively across multiple sites and stakeholders

- Excellent relationship-building skills with a high level of visibility and credibility

- Strong analytical mindset with willingness to deep dive into issues  and drive root cause solutions

- Proven ability to identify, drive, and sustain process improvements

- True team player mindset , with a collaborative approach and focus on supporting colleagues

- High resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

- Strong communication, coaching, and influencing skills

- Data-driven and solution-oriented, with strong execution focus

- Ability to balance operational excellence with strategic thinking

Unlock the potential of your future!

Your work environment

Working at GXO Logistics means working in a dynamic and international organization. An exciting environment where there is plenty of room for personal input and development. Employees at GXO Logistics are in charge of their own success. Whatever your role at GXO Logistics, you face new challenges every day, allowing you to develop to your full potential. Jouw rol

Als HR Business Partner ben jij hét senior HR-aanspreekpunt op onze locatie in Tilburg. Samen met je HR-collega’s ondersteun en adviseer je zowel leidinggevenden als medewerkers over een breed scala aan HR-vraagstukken. - Je hebt een afgeronde HBO opleiding op het gebied van HR, of een vergelijkbaar kennisniveau

- Je hebt werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie, bij voorkeur in een logistieke (of andere dynamische) omgeving

- Een zelfstandige functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid, waar je iedere dag voor nieuwe uitdagingen komt te staan

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, come join us at GXO!

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

- Lead the establishment and ongoing enhancement of export/import compliance standards, guidelines and monitoring procedures for GXO’s operations in the USA and in partnership with the Director, Trade Compliance and external trade compliance counsel.

- Drive the implementation and effectiveness of ITAR / EAR, import, and customs compliance control policies, procedures, and resources through training, communication, and process improvements.

- Proactively identify and address compliance risks, driving continuous improvement initiatives and implementing sustainable solutions.

- Partner with operational leadership, customers and functional teams to implement practical and effective trade compliance controls.

- Maintain compliance with DDTC registration and reporting requirements, working with internal stakeholders and external counsel as required.

- Oversee compliance with ITAR and EAR regulated operations, driving risk mitigation and process improvements.

- Monitor and interpret regulatory developments (ITAR, EAR, customs, sanctions), ensuring the business remains informed and compliant.

- Provide operational and reporting support for queries related to ACE.

- Support business units with import, export, sanctions and customs compliance matters.

- Support the standardization of trade compliance processes and assist with trade compliance-related matters relevant to the North/South American offices.

- Review and enhance Restricted Party Screening and Enhanced Due Diligence processes, identifying opportunities for improvement.

- Support internal investigations into potential trade compliance issues and coordinate corrective actions where required.

- Support and assist with other aspects of the Compliance team work as required, such as compliance audits and visits, reviews, awareness and training on the GXO Code of Business Ethics and its associated policies, anti-bribery and anti-trust.

- The role will require travel primarily within the USA.

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience

- 7-10 years of work experience in U.S. import/export regulations and trade compliance.

- Strong expertise in U.S. customs software and systems, ACE and EEI filings.

- Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders across operational, commercial and corporate functions.

- Experience with Mexico and Canadian customs frameworks.

- Advanced knowledge of export regulations, ITAR and EAR and customs regulations.

- Advanced knowledge about United States economic sanctions regulations, with particular emphasis on the Office of Foreign Assets (OFAC) sanctions and general knowledge about U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry Security (BIS) and U.S. State Department, Directorate of Defense Trade Controls (DDTC) export control regulations, Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA)

- Strong Microsoft Office skills including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

- Travel Requirement: up to 25% primarily within the United States.

It’d be great if you also have:

- Free trade qualification experience (USMCA and IMMEX)

- Knowledge of the logistics and / or supply chain business

- Experience working with 3PL customers on import and export issues

- Knowledge of FAR and DEFAR compliance

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

As the Senior Warehouse Operations Supervisor, you will focus on building a culture that supports high employee morale and ensures company policies and procedures are met. We want to utilize your experience to improve employee engagement and maintain clear and frequent communication at every level.

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

- Establish work schedules, assign jobs and train staff

- Guide, counsel and encourage employees; improve potential and champion high standards

- Establish and maintain effective relationships with onsite customers and other key partners

- Provide a safe and secure work environment through training and safety inspections

- Assist with evaluating employee performance, providing written and verbal feedback

- Implement and carry out all company policies, procedures and standards

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

- 3 years of relevant experience

- Experience with Microsoft Office and computerized scanner equipment

- Availability to work a flexible schedule as needed, including planned and unplanned overtime, which may include weekends

It’d be great if you also have:

- Bachelor's degree in Logistics or a related field, or equivalent related work or military experience

- 3 years of managerial/supervisory experience

- Bilingual English/Spanish

- Experience in an AS9100 or ISO environment

- Warehousing or Third-Party Logistics (3PL) experience

- Solid problem-solving skills

- Proven ability to follow, promote and implement safety programs

This job requires the ability to:

- Lift objects of various shapes, sizes and weights

- Stand, sit or walk for extended periods of time

- Reach (including above your head), bend, stoop, climb, push, pull, twist, squat and kneel

- Handle or manage tools or equipment

- Tolerate hot or cold warehouse environments

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement here.
